lesson.title: Build an angle, then reason
lesson.subtitle: P4 angle revision
lesson.objective: Practise constructing an angle and find its supplementary angle.
lesson.story: An angle is drawn on a protractor.

steps.title: Build, then reason
steps.prompt: Practise building a 10° angle. What is the size of the adjacent angle that completes a straight line? Construction is practice; your derived answer is checked.
hints: Find the corner and a side of the angle.
Angles on a straight line add to 180 degrees.
Use the alignment help to centre and turn the dial.

steps.title: Compare with a right angle
steps.prompt: Is the original angle acute, right or obtuse? This question has no movable preview.
hints: Use a right angle as a reference.
The original angle is 10°. Compare it with 90°.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: Why does the choice of zero matter?

choices.label: Use the same named scale for every pose, wherever the two arms happen to point.
Start at zero on the arm you line up with, then measure to the other arm.
Always choose the larger of the two printed numbers on the dial for the angle.

hints: Think about where the measured turn begins.
The two scales run in opposite directions.
Turning the dial may change which scale you use.
Choose the explanation about starting at zero on the aligned arm.
